about: Novel first published in installments 1905-1906, narrated by a cat living in a teacher's house.

title: The Woman in White

title: Moby-Dick

about: Novel from 1851: a whaling voyage and its captain, with long digressions on whales.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
